name: PDF as URF
description: Every PDF rendered by PDFium on a CUPS queue, for the macOS run of issue 29. A macOS queue fails every PWG Raster job in its filters, so each job here must be sent as image/urf: the log line after each submission names the engine and the format. Watch every job to job-completed rather than trusting the submission. Compare the sides and the colour of each sheet with its description, and the anchored label with the placement sheet of pdf-placement.
